key_insight: Recognizing an image is not the same as tracking a world beyond the camera’s view. This paper probes whether visual foundation models represent a persistent spatial state, though the provided abstract does not include findings.
problem_solved: How can we assess whether visual foundation models retain spatial information about unseen surroundings and update it as an observer moves?
method: Probe visual foundation models through a hierarchy of spatial capabilities.

impact: This evaluation perspective could help practitioners distinguish image-recognition ability from the spatial representations needed for navigation and embodied AI. Specific performance conclusions are unavailable in the provided excerpt.
